attempts.fact_text: Each cow has a unique spot pattern, just like a fingerprint or snowflake! No two cows have exactly the same pattern of spots.
attempts.source_note: Animal Diversity Web (animaldiversity.org) - Bos taurus account, and Smithsonian's National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute (nationalzoo.si.edu)

problems: Plausibility/source-grounding: the card asserts a universal ('Each cow...', 'No two cows...') but many common cattle breeds (e.g. solid-colored ones) have no spots at all, so the claim as written is not accurate for cows generally. The well-supported version of this fact is about patterned breeds — it should be scoped, e.g. 'Cows with spots each have their own one-of-a-kind pattern.'

attempts.fact_text: Baby calves are ready to move! A newborn calf can already stand up and walk within just an hour of being born.
attempts.source_note: nationalzoo.si.edu (Cow) and en.wikipedia.org (Cattle) — both confirm calves are born precocial, able to stand and walk within an hour of birth.
